shots.headline: Weigh it. Know what's left.
shots.sub: Pick the brand, type the gross weight from your kitchen scale. Grams left, % left, value and a LOW flag follow. Google Sheets and Excel.

shots.headline: Empty-spool weights for 14 brands
shots.sub: The Tare DB holds measured empty-spool weights from the meshkit.pro community database; add your own in the yellow rows and they join the dropdown.

shots.headline: Your shelf, in numbers
shots.sub: Summary totals grams and value on hand, counts low and unweighed spools, and charts what is left by material.

shots.headline: Log your dry boxes
shots.sub: One row per humidity reading. Anything above the warning level on Settings is flagged HIGH, and Summary counts those readings.

log.caption: Dry Box Log
log.note: humidity as a percent, flagged against the Settings warning level

summary.caption: Summary
summary.note: HIGH readings counted, last reading dated

shots.headline: Google Sheets and Excel 2016+
shots.sub: No macros, no add-ons, formulas you can inspect.
notes: Open the .xlsx in Excel, or upload it to Google Drive and open with Sheets.
Sheets are protected against accidental edits; unprotect with no password.
Plain formulas only: IF, VLOOKUP, IFERROR, SUMIFS, COUNTIF, MAX.
shots.formula_caption: Spools!K5, the grams-left cell: gross weight minus the tare from the Tare DB

faq.a: Instant download after purchase: one .xlsx file and a Read-Me-First PDF.
Both. Excel 2016 or newer, or upload to Google Drive and open with Sheets. No macros or add-ons.
60 spool rows, 100 dry box readings and 15 custom tare rows; four sample spools are included to overwrite.

faq.q: What can I do with it?
faq.a: Personal and small-business use on your own devices. Please do not resell or share the file.
Updated versions are added to the same listing; re-download from your Etsy purchases at no charge.
